nodes.title: Filter

nodes.title: Point Values
nodes.label: Point Values

nodes.summary: Choose panel where networked, loop and address, then F5 Enter. View the programmed type, detected type/mode and reported sensor value. F5 Print prints the selected loop, not just this point.

nodes.title: View Faults
nodes.label: View Faults
nodes.hint: This option is view only. Read fault point references and use View Status to inspect a specific programmed device; a displayed fault is not a cable-location proof.
nodes.summary: This option is view only. Read fault point references and use View Status to inspect a specific programmed device; a displayed fault is not a cable-location proof.

nodes.title: Loop Point Counters
nodes.label: Loop Point Counters
nodes.hint: Select panel where networked and loop, then F5 Enter. The source describes an approximately two-minute real scan. PASSED requires matching configured/detected counts, no unconfigured points and equal left/right/both counts. FINDR uses an explicitly synthetic immediate result.
nodes.summary: Select panel where networked and loop, then F5 Enter. The source describes an approximately two-minute real scan. PASSED requires matching configured/detected counts, no unconfigured points and equal left/right/both counts. FINDR uses an explicitly synthetic immediate result.

notes: Use softkey F2 from the documented parent screen; its action follows the displayed label.
nodes.title: Details
nodes.label: Details
nodes.hint: From Loop Point Counters press F2 Details. F2 >> pages all 250 addresses: o connected/configured/identified, c configured but not connected/identified, u connected but not configured. These are addresses, never physical cable sequence.
nodes.summary: From Loop Point Counters press F2 Details. F2 >> pages all 250 addresses: o connected/configured/identified, c configured but not connected/identified, u connected but not configured. These are addresses, never physical cable sequence.

notes: Use softkey F3 from the documented parent screen; its action follows the displayed label.
nodes.title: Scan
nodes.label: Scan
nodes.hint: From Loop Point Counters press F3 Scan. F2 >> pages addresses: . empty, * seen from both sides, l left only, r right only. This is an investigation aid and cannot establish physical cable order or a break location.
nodes.summary: From Loop Point Counters press F3 Scan. F2 >> pages addresses: . empty, * seen from both sides, l left only, r right only. This is an investigation aid and cannot establish physical cable order or a break location.

notes: Panel field only on a network. Point scope uses Location Loop, Zone and Point.
Automatic self-test applies only to detector type; the manual lists 801PH, 801CH and 801I. Lasertest is not used.
Sounder test pulses selected sounders and displays no results. Full multisensor test requires both sensing modes; Part depends on configured active modes.
Isolated points are excluded. Ending the session is blocked while any selected input remains active.
nodes.title: Walk Test
nodes.label: Walk Test
nodes.hint: Select the exact scope before F5 Start; only one session may run. F3 Settings reviews the chosen scope. F5 End is allowed only once all selected points are inactive. Keep alarm/monitoring arrangements and restoration explicit.
nodes.summary: Select the exact scope before F5 Start; only one session may run. F3 Settings reviews the chosen scope. F5 End is allowed only once all selected points are inactive. Keep alarm/monitoring arrangements and restoration explicit.

nodes.title: Fire Alarm Cycle Count

nodes.hint: View the number of fire-alarm sequences. This number is a historic counter, not evidence that a current fault is repaired.
nodes.summary: View the number of fire-alarm sequences. This number is a historic counter, not evidence that a current fault is repaired.

nodes.title: Maintenance Request
nodes.label: Maintenance Request
nodes.hint: Shows detectors approaching their threshold-compensation limit. F5 prints when a printer is configured; inspect the actual equipment and applicable maintenance instructions.

nodes.title: Battery Test

navigation.action: 0 normal; I enable. Operator 1 needs no passcode. Higher profiles are site-configured.
